candidates.concept_granularity: single object-oriented method-redefinition mechanism

candidates.title: 불변 객체
candidates.concept_granularity: single object given its values at construction and exposing only getters, used when a value handed outside must be guaranteed not to change - String being the standard example, since none of its methods alter its contents

candidates.title: super 예약어
candidates.concept_granularity: single keyword referring to the parent instance, whose constructor form may appear only inside a constructor and only on its first line, and which every constructor must call

candidates.title: 컴파일 타임에 삽입되는 super()
candidates.concept_granularity: single compile-time insertion putting a bare super() at the head of any constructor that does not call one itself, which is why an empty subclass still runs its parent's constructor

candidates.title: 부모에 기본 생성자가 없을 때
candidates.concept_granularity: single compile failure that follows when a parent declares constructors but no no-argument one, forcing every child constructor to call a parent constructor explicitly

candidates.title: 추상 클래스 배열을 통한 일반화
candidates.concept_granularity: single technique of declaring an array of the parent type so every descendant can sit in it and be handled as one kind, which is what makes an Object array able to hold anything

candidates.title: final 클래스
candidates.concept_granularity: single class marked so that nothing may inherit from it, the mirror image of the abstract class that cannot be instantiated and therefore requires a child

candidates.title: 인터페이스는 기능의 목록이다
candidates.concept_granularity: single design stance treating the interface as the list of what must exist, so the work starts by naming the functions and grouping the related ones rather than by implementing anything

candidates.title: 인터페이스 멤버의 기본 제한자
candidates.concept_granularity: single rule that every interface field is public static final and every method public abstract, with the modifiers implied when omitted, which is why a field is reachable through the interface name and a method must be overridden by the implementer

candidates.title: 팩토리 메서드 패턴
candidates.concept_granularity: single pattern hiding how an instance is built and returning only the finished object, so the caller asks a factory for it instead of running new itself

candidates.title: 리플렉션
candidates.concept_granularity: single facility for naming a class as a string, having the class loader find it on the classpath, creating an instance from that information and invoking a method by name - which is how code can run against a class whose name it learns only at run time

candidates.title: 익명 클래스
candidates.concept_granularity: single class written as a constructor call followed by a body, which overrides what it needs on the spot and is used where the type will not be reused - the way an abstract class or interface gets instantiated without a named subclass

candidates.title: 람다 인터페이스
candidates.concept_granularity: single interface carrying exactly one method, which is what lets an anonymous object be shortened into a lambda expression - a JDK 8 addition and part of what modern Java means, especially alongside the Stream API

candidates.title: 문자열 비교
candidates.concept_granularity: single rule that string values are compared with equals rather than by reference, alongside the transformation methods that return a new string instead of altering the original
